_note: Hand-written names and notes for places that matter to a player, keyed by place family (a prefab name with its digits removed, so Crypt2, Crypt3 and Crypt4 are 'Crypt'). Zone and how many the game places come from the game files; the notes below are from public guides, not checked in game, and the site tags them so. Places not listed here still appear, with a name made from the prefab name.

Crypt.name: Burial Chamber
Crypt.note: Black Forest dungeon (three layouts). Skeletons, Rancid Remains and ghosts inside; no key needed. Chests give Surtling Cores, Amber, Coins and Bone Fragments.

TrollCave.name: Troll Cave
TrollCave.note: Black Forest cave with at least one Troll inside. Loot is mostly Amber, Bone Fragments, Deer Hide, Feathers and Coins. Bear caves look almost the same from outside.

SunkenCrypt.name: Sunken Crypt
SunkenCrypt.note: Swamp dungeon. The door needs the Swamp Key (The Elder drops it). Blobs, Draugr and Draugr Elite inside; chests give Scrap Iron, Ancient Bark, Chain, Withered Bone and Coins.

MountainCave.name: Frost Cave
MountainCave.note: Mountain dungeon behind a stone entrance. No key needed. Guides disagree on what lives inside (Cultists and a caged Fenring are mentioned) and what it drops.

CharredFortress.name: Charred Fortress
CharredFortress.note: Ashlands fortress. The Bell Altar in its central tower gives the Bell Fragments needed for Bells; a Vegvisir there can mark Fader's arena.

Vendor_BlackForest.name: Haldor the Trader
Vendor_BlackForest.note: A merchant camp in the Black Forest; sells and buys for Coins. There is one Haldor per world, at one of these spots.

Hildir_camp.name: Hildir's camp
Hildir_camp.note: Hildir, a merchant who gives quests.

Hildir_cave.name: Hildir's quest: cave
Hildir_cave.note: A place from Hildir's quests (a chest to find).
